question: Do 64 recovered monetary observations change the prior descriptive consumption-profile research decision?
scope: Case1 retrospective descriptive attribution only; no forecast, causal claim, new clusters, SME join or new feature family
primary_target: Mean squared OOF error over five CLR coordinates of annual mean monthly normalized category profiles; equal municipality weight
secondary_target: Log annual mean monthly published total spending
population: Identical frozen core_eligible and conservative_eligible municipality-years; additions change feature coverage only
new_features: Unchanged log(published thousand_rubles*1000 / beginning-of-year population_total), positive finite observations only, investment/shipments/retail
model: Ridge alpha=1; train-only medians and population-SD scaling; train-only categorical vocabulary; unchanged core/eight industry shares and missing flags
folds: Exact round4 recovered_full municipality-key folds; subsets retain corresponding core fold assignments and never reassign municipalities
paired_flags_recovery_interpretation: Same rows/folds and both vintages' missing flags; old vs new values, with preprocessing refitted in training folds; not causal or a pure coefficient effect
comparisons: Same three primary comparison families plus missingness, whole monetary block and legacy increment for context
old_prediction_check: legacy_full core/stable predictions must match prior round4 recovered_full at atol1e-9/rtol1e-9
invariance_check: common_complete_new3 old/new values and predictions coincide at atol1e-9/rtol1e-9
excluded_region_sensitivity: Refit on core without both recovery regions using restricted prior core folds. Old/new inputs are identical by construction, so state/shared recovery must be zero. This is an invariance check, not independent evidence about the 64 additions. Primary flags-to-values remains a descriptive test of the full existing block elsewhere; do not compare its score with full-core as a paired causal contrast
uncertainty: 2000 paired region-bootstrap resamples of fixed OOF row losses, seed13, percentile95%; no pipeline refit, multiple-testing adjustment, or claim of untouched test data
negative_controls: Not rerun: unchanged algorithm/feature family; round4 permutations remain prior diagnostics. This follow-up isolates additional observed values and does not claim new falsification evidence
ablations: Not rerun: unchanged three monetary attributes and no retuning. Prior ablations remain prior evidence; expanded_complete omitted to avoid another composition comparison
slice_interpretation: Postfit descriptive loss contributions, affected32MO vs unaffected and two recovery regions vs others. No separate interval on the affected slice because it contains only two region clusters; unmodified test rows can change predictions when training inputs are updated
adoption: Unchanged no-reversal criterion: primary profile gain >=1% in both years and both regimes, lower95% CI >0, and nonnegative gain (>=0) in each stable-code counterpart; otherwise retain descriptive-context status
adoption_operator_note: Preserve round4 independent verifier's stable >=0 interpretation of no reversal; round4 descriptive readout used >0. Exact zero stable gain satisfies no reversal here; this choice is fixed before new results
availability: Current 2026 snapshots of contemporaneous annual values; first publication and revision times unknown; historical real-time availability not established
evaluation_contacts: Years, municipal examples and prior errors already inspected. Entire follow-up exploratory; no independent new heldout dataset
prohibited_inferences: resident income from activity per person
historical boundary identity from code presence
unique SME firms from period rows
sum of workers across repeated records or missing IP workers
